description: Compose and render background music locally as a seamless stereo WAV loop (the WAV carries a loop point; one full piece with intro, themes and outro, about 1-2 minutes). Every seed is a different piece in the same style. Moods: calm (Calm Eastern piece: guqin and bamboo flute over strings. Exploration, villages, menus.); battle (Eastern battle music: pipa, spiccato low strings and big war drums. Combat, bosses.); mystery (Sparse, misty Eastern piece: flute and guqin over held strings, wooden fish. Caves, ruins, night.); sad (Slow erhu lament over strings and guqin. Loss, farewells, sad story beats.); primitive (Stone age: bone flute over a hummed drone, log drums, clapping sticks and a shaker. Cavemen, tribal camps, prehistory.); tribal (Early village: clay ocarina (xun) and bamboo flute, plucked zither, frame and log drums, low hum. Farming villages, early civilisation.); medieval (Medieval folk tune in dorian: fiddle and shawm, lute, bagpipe drone, frame drum and tambourine. Towns, taverns, markets, castles.); chiptune (8-bit overworld theme in a major key: square-wave lead, fast arpeggios, triangle bass, noise drums. Retro platformers, title screens.); chipBoss (8-bit boss or dungeon theme in harmonic minor: fast square leads, driving bass and busy noise drums. Retro boss fights, dungeons.); adventure (Western adventure: violins over picked nylon guitar and a string bed, light drum kit, major key. Exploration, overworld, fantasy towns.); action (Rock action: distorted lead guitar, palm-muted power chords, electric bass, full drum kit, harmonic minor. Combat, chases, racing.); acoustic (Warm acoustic: nylon guitar and flute over strummed steel-string guitar, soft bass, brushes. Campfires, farms, cozy and life-sim games.); fantasy (Fantasy orchestral: flute, oboe and horn over harp and strings, timpani at the big moments, major key. Kingdoms, overworld, RPG towns.); epic (Epic orchestral battle: horns and trumpets over driving cello spiccato, brass stabs and timpani, harmonic minor. Boss fights, sieges, trailers.); piano (Reflective solo piano over soft strings, minor key. Menus, memories, sad or quiet story moments.); pastoral (Pastoral woodwinds: clarinet, oboe and flute over rolled harp chords and light strings, major key. Villages, farms, peaceful meadows.); lofi (Chill Lo-Fi beats: warm electric piano chords, dusty koto/guitar melody, deep bass and relaxed room drums.); synthwave (Retro cyberpunk Synthwave: driving 80s synth bass, lush warm pad, bright saw lead and 808/electronic drums.); jrpg (Classic JRPG town/field theme: flute & piano melody over lush strings, harp arpeggios and light percussion.); dungeon (Dark dungeon & boss tension: low brass/cello ostinato, dark choir pad, organ chords and heavy taiko/timpani.). Also renders short stingers instead when "stinger" is given: victory (Bright drum hit, pipa run and bell. Win, quest complete.); defeat (Falling guqin, low bell and erhu. Loss, game over.); battleStart (Three war drum hits and a gong. A fight begins.); treasure (Rising chimes and a bell. Treasure, rare item.); breakthrough (Low bell, rising guqin and flute. Level up, realm breakthrough.); guiltCannibal (About 2 s, quiet: an erhu note sags down over a low hum. A dark deed (eating your own kind).); guiltChild (About 2 s, quiet: two ocarina notes a semitone apart. A terrible deed (harming a child).); grief (About 2.5 s, quiet: a low hum with two guqin notes. Someone close has died.); chipWin (8-bit: rising square-wave arpeggio onto a held major chord. Level clear, win (retro games).); chipLose (8-bit: three falling notes, the last sagging flat. Life lost, game over (retro games).); fanfare (Orchestral: trumpet call over a timpani roll, landing on a full brass chord with a cymbal. Victory, royal entrance, quest complete.).

instruments.description: Override SoundFont instruments per role (melody, pad, accomp, bass, drums), e.g. {"melody": "altoSax", "drums": "kit808"}

out_path.description: WAV file to write, e.g. "assets/music/town.wav". With count > 1, files get -01, -02 ... suffixes.

seed.description: Seed for a reproducible piece; piece i uses seed + i

stems_dir.description: Directory to write individual track stem WAVs (melody.wav, pad.wav, accomp.wav, bass.wav, drums.wav) when using SoundFont moods or tracks

stinger.description: Render this short stinger instead of a loop

tracks.description: Custom multi-track MIDI note array for SoundFont rendering

name: generate_music
title: Compose a music loop
